summary: Final acceptance passes at 55f4e967. The earlier blockers F1, F2 part 2, and F3 are closed. One item remains: 197 nested [ ] sub-boxes in plan.md. The PM decision of 2026-11-24 records this item as a known checker gap, so it does not block this pass. The structured helper timeout (F4) stays an accepted Major row in tech-debt.md. Production code, tests, scripts, and gates are unchanged since the earlier run, so its sweeps stand.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] final-acceptance: Known checker gap, 197 nested [ ] sub-boxes in plan.md (PM decision 2026-11-24). plan_closeout_feedback reports 197 items at HEAD: 193 under [x] tasks and 4 under the deferred live smoke test at plan.md:671. It reports 0 completed lines without a SHA and 0 incomplete top-level tasks. The role gate counts top-level tasks only. The closeout gate counts indented sub-boxes, so the closeout plan check lists these 197 items until the checker changes or the PM waives them. Measure owns the fix. I did not tick any box.

F2 [Major] final-acceptance: The structured helper has no request timeout (earlier F4, accepted by the PM as nonblocking tech-debt). structured.ts:151-155 builds the client with no timeoutMs, and structured.ts:195-229 sends with no timeout. The only abort path is the optional request.abortSignal at structured.ts:51, and no app caller sets it. The old paths used 15000 ms. The row is at tech-debt.md:47. The first small task of the next track restores the 15000 ms timeout with a stalled-provider test.

F3 [Nit] final-acceptance: Phase S4 holds two passing phase-acceptance results: phase-acceptance-8b66cbf4.json and phase-acceptance-55f4e96.json. The rule asks for exactly one passing result for each phase. The result at 55f4e967 re-audits the same phase on the later HEAD and is the binding result. The result at 8b66cbf4 is superseded. S1, S2, and S3 hold one passing result each. The orchestrator may keep both as history or move the older file.

The delta is one SDK chunk of about 0.84 MB raw in each app. The BM2 total is 10035.04 KB against a 3000 KB budget that baseline already exceeded. No tech-debt.md row records this.
